requirementsCrosswalk.implementationFinding: Workspace finalization/synchronization, repository restoration, and company purge/erasure have distinct owners. requirementsCrosswalk.remainingWork: Bind actual workspace exports/restores to exact source identity and privacy/deletion receipts; fail closed on missing provenance and label irrecoverable data loss instead of fabricating successful reconstruction.

requirementsCrosswalk.bindingClause: | V10-163 | Qualified production bundle and bounded performance changes | UP-10 / PERF / REL; B/H | Actual artifact boots, runs and stops; measured improvement preserves current rights |
requirementsCrosswalk.implementationFinding: Production image/runner and bounded performance owners exist with a recorded runtime qualification workstream. This source review cannot establish that the exact current production artifact boots, executes, stops, or preserves model/provider/accounting rights under measured load.

requirementsCrosswalk.bindingClause: | V10-164 | Short activation composition over retained logical states | UX-02/03 / ONB-01–12; C | No fabricated skipped step, duplicate command, required project/website or technical first-run setup |
requirementsCrosswalk.implementationFinding: Activation has a retained staged state, first-Agent/task preparation, verified first-value receipt, completion revalidation, and a UI that exposes resume/current-stage behavior. Its code expressly represents optional website as `not_requested`. The retained 012 browser attempt passed the first-value test and failed the separate password-reset selector; it is not evidence of an activation product defect. No missing transition/duplicate command was reproduced.
requirementsCrosswalk.remainingWork: Qualify one supported profile end-to-end, including resume, skip/failure, and real first-value. Treat the failed password-reset selector as test evidence only unless current UI behavior is independently shown incorrect.

requirementsCrosswalk.bindingClause: | V10-165 | Real human result-review and revision lifecycle | ONB-11R / MEM-03; C/D | Owner/admin review is explicit; member handoff and terminal-plan revision preserve authority and evidence |
requirementsCrosswalk.implementationFinding: Human review/feedback, management review and offboarding/member authority have separate owners. The full result review/revision lifecycle—including member handoff, terminal plan revision, ownership and evidence preservation—is not established as a unified state machine.
requirementsCrosswalk.remainingWork: Complete human/admin review semantics at original owner rows, including immutable result/version, explicit accepted/rejected/revise states, successor authority and audit; keep agent self-approval disabled.

requirementsCrosswalk.bindingClause: | V10-166 | Complete auth/recovery/reauthentication and bilingual mail | CE-03 / AUTH; A/C | Every offered login method has a secure usable lifecycle and EN/DA delivery |
requirementsCrosswalk.implementationFinding: Beyond the credential and mail/recovery flows already recorded, current account-deletion software now has scoped passwordless OIDC and signed SAML fresh-reauthentication, bound to the active user/session, current qualified provider policy and one-use challenge. It preserves native factor policy: TOTP/recovery-code completion and already-enrolled UV WebAuthn passkeys are exercised for configured operator and local operator paths; ordinary native passkey sign-in remains usable while enterprise identity is disabled. They do not qualify every login method/profile, physical authenticator behavior, real enterprise IdP configuration/interoperability, all recovery/reset/revoke branches, or complete EN/DA mail and customer journeys.
requirementsCrosswalk.remainingWork: Close CE-03 across every actually offered profile and method from enrollment through recovery, reset, fresh reauthentication and revoke; validate provider-specific IdP behavior and physical authenticators, concurrent MFA/recovery cases, canonical domains, deliverability, anti-enumeration, and complete EN/DA customer journeys.

requirementsCrosswalk.bindingClause: | V10-167 | Complete paired copy and rendered state acceptance | §35 / UX-01; C–H | Both locales preserve action, actor, cost, data and status meaning across all critical states |

requirementsCrosswalk.remainingWork: Complete the source-derived critical-state inventory and verify action, actor, cost, data and status meaning in rendered EN and DA screens, including screenshots, accessibility/truncation and customer acceptance; rerun against frozen current source after copy changes.

requirementsCrosswalk.bindingClause: | V10-168 | Mandatory beta profile and exact live evidence dossier | §§47/55; H | No required capability hidden by narrowing claims; real source/runtime/human/operator evidence |
